data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to access device thermal state and detect thermal throttling.
data.what_it_does: It allows Flutter apps to access the current thermal state of the device and listen to thermal status changes. Additionally, it provides a stream to watch battery temperature changes on Android.
use_when: You want to detect if the user's device is undergoing thermal throttling
You need to monitor battery or device temperature changes to adjust app workloads
avoid_when: You need detailed hardware diagnostics beyond thermal status and battery temperature
strengths: Simple API to query thermal status
Stream-based updates for thermal status changes and battery temperature
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding platform-specific limitations or supported versions
Battery temperature tracking is Android-only based on changelog
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. Follow standard platform configuration if required by native thermal APIs.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general hardware and OS device information if thermal metrics are not strictly required.
